entries.title: Interplay between high-harmonic generation and photoluminescence in ZnO: Anisotropic spectral properties of harmonic emission and the role of excitons,
entries.bibliographic_entry: S. P. S. Jessen, M. Mero, M. J. J. Vrakking, R. M. Turtos, P. Balling, and P. B 112, 214311 (2025); DOI: 10.1103/b56l-hvgn; arXiv:2508.09364 [physics.optics]. 块体 ZnO 在短波红外强场激发下 HHG（奇次谐波、相干）与光致发光（非相干、近带边）双通道对比。第五次谐波在强度驱动下出现谱形转变、主导机制切换，该转变强度即正文 I_threshold 基准值。

entries.title: Probing Berry phase effect in topological surface states,
entries.bibliographic_entry: Y. Bai, Y. Jiang, W. Zheng, H. Xu, J. Chen, S. Wang, C. Liu, R. Li, and P. Liu, "Probing Berry phase effect in topological surface states," Phys. Rev. Lett. 133, 243801 (2024); DOI: 10.1103/PhysRevLett.133.243801. Bi₂Se₃ 拓扑表面态（TSSs）电子-空穴准粒子在强场驱动下沿演化路径累积带间 Berry 相位，电子-空穴对量子路径被几何相位形变，偶次谐波振荡相位出现系统性移动，揭示 Berry 相位对谐波调制的可观测性；该效应可增强光场对强自旋-轨道耦合量子材料中电子自旋的调控。上海光机所、上海科技大学与张江实验室联合工作。
